Demeter: GODDESS OF AGRICULTURE, HARVEST, AND THE FERTILITY OF THE EARTH.
Artemisa: GODDESS OF THE HUNT, WILD NATURE, AND THE MOON.
Apolo: GOD OF THE SUN, MUSIC, POETRY, PROPHECY, AND HEALING.
Zeus: GOD OF GODS, LORD OF THUNDER, PROTECTOR OF LAWS AND JUSTICE.
Hera: QUEEN OF THE GODS, PROTECTOR OF MARRIAGE, FAMILY, AND WOMEN.
Ares: GOD OF WAR, BRUTAL FORCE, AND COURAGE IN COMBAT.
Hermes: MESSENGER GOD, GUIDE OF TRAVELERS, COMMERCE, AND WIT.
Atena: GODDESS OF WISDOM, MILITARY STRATEGY, AND CRAFTS.
Poseidon: LORD OF THE SEAS, OCEANS, EARTHQUAKES, AND HORSES.
Afrodita: GODDESS OF LOVE, BEAUTY, PASSION, AND DESIRE.
Hestia: GODDESS OF THE HEARTH, SACRED FIRE, AND FAMILY HARMONY.
Hefesto: GOD OF FIRE, THE FORGE, METALLURGY, AND CRAFTSMANSHIP.
